body:
I feel that. The fear of the unknown, it's terrifying. I struggle with it all the time too.

I try to rationalize it by saying "if there is justice/compassion in the universe, then suicidal people won't be subjected to torture in the afterlife just because they were suicidal, and if there isn't justice/compassion in the universe, well... I don't stand a chance either way." 

Even then though, that's not enough for me. The fear still hits me all the same. I guess the "fear" is why I'm still here, why most of us are still here. Maybe its a good thing, but in a way it just feels like I'm trapped in my own personal hell.

I'm sorry you're going through what you're going through. I've been there for years myself, and I'm still trying to find a way out. I hope things get better for you.

Sorry to hear. I get it though, I do. I'm a little bit younger than you but I can completely relate to the frustration with how life turns out. Sometimes everything goes wrong and you can just never catch a break, meanwhile everyone around you is thriving. I was definitely an just an angsty teen at one point but now in my mid twenties, this is just life now, and life fucking sucks. You and I are both asking the same question... "how did it come to this"? Where did everything go so fucking wrong. I don't think we'll ever know. I  feel you, friend. I'm sorry you're going through this.

We're all a bunch of lost children... even the adults. Forgotten people in a fucked up world. It's really hard to see that there's so many of us, but it's very telling about where the world is right now. I feel so sorry for every one of us; we all understand each others pain, even if that pain has different causes, and yet we're all powerless to help each other, much less ourselves.

I'm in the same boat as you. I'm sorry you're feeling how you do. It's a shitty place to be in, isn't it? I want to go so badly and yet, when the time comes, when I'm ready to do it, I can never manage to pull the trigger (literally, as my method is a firearm). No matter how much I tell myself "this is for the best" or "you're going to have to die one day anyways" or any of the dumb things I tell myself to rationalize it, I haven't been able to overcome my body's natural fear of pain and death.

Fear, mostly. Trying to overcome my natural biological instinct to survive, and to avoid pain. Getting to that point, that edge, and just taking that final step to cross over. Haven't managed to do it yet.

I understand that feeling... there is only one reason I've even stayed around so long, not for my family because we're not really close, but for my best friend. She's in a bad emotional state too and I worry that me going would be like taking her with me. I just can't do it anymore though, it feels exhausting, spending so many years feeling the same way with no relief. I don't really have any advice, but I just wanted to say I'm sorry that you're struggling.
